name: Facilitation Payments and Third-Party Intermediaries
description: Small unofficial payments to speed routine government actions, and wider use of agents, customs brokers, distributors or joint-venture partners who may pass value to officials. These flows are often small, cash-heavy and poorly documented, so detection relies on expense analytics, supplier controls and awareness.

sources.text: OECD, Good Practice Guidance on Internal Controls, Ethics, and Compliance (2010)
OECD, UNODC and World Bank, Anti-Corruption Ethics and Compliance Handbook for Business (2013)
Wolfsberg Group, Anti-Bribery and Corruption Compliance Programme Guidance (2017)
US DOJ and SEC, A Resource Guide to the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, Second Edition (2020)

indicators.name: Recurring small cash payments to border, customs or permit agents
indicators.canon: Recurring small cash payments to border, customs or permit agents
indicators.desc: Repeated low-value cash disbursements or petty cash entries labelled 'expediting', 'facilitation' or 'processing' at ports, borders or ministries.
indicators.ctx: Repeated low-value cash disbursements or petty cash entries labelled 'expediting', 'facilitation' or 'processing' at ports, borders or ministries.
indicators.fp: Some official fees are legitimately paid in cash with receipts.

indicators.name: Customs broker or freight forwarder with unusually high disbursements
indicators.canon: Customs broker or freight forwarder with unusually high disbursements
indicators.desc: Broker invoices include large unitemised 'disbursements' or 'duties' that exceed published tariffs.
indicators.ctx: Broker invoices include large unitemised 'disbursements' or 'duties' that exceed published tariffs.
indicators.fp: Duties vary with classification and valuation disputes.

indicators.name: Third party has no anti-bribery policy or refuses audit rights
indicators.canon: Third party has no anti-bribery policy or refuses audit rights
indicators.desc: Intermediary resists contractual anti-corruption clauses, books-and-records access, or certification.
indicators.ctx: Intermediary resists contractual anti-corruption clauses, books-and-records access, or certification.
indicators.fp: Small suppliers may lack formal policies but cooperate otherwise.

indicators.name: Payment requested in cash or to personal account
indicators.canon: Payment directed to personal or third-party account
indicators.desc: Payment is requested to, or credited to, a personal, third-party or differently named account rather than the contracted payee.
indicators.ctx: Intermediary asks that fees be paid in cash, via third parties, or into a personal rather than corporate account.
indicators.fp: Individual consultants sometimes invoice from personal accounts.

indicators.name: Intermediary introduced by official or customer insists on use
indicators.canon: Intermediary introduced by official or customer insists on use
indicators.desc: A government contact recommends or demands a specific agent, with limited competitive selection.
indicators.ctx: A government contact recommends or demands a specific agent, with limited competitive selection.
indicators.fp: Local requirements may legitimately mandate local partners.

indicators.name: Expense claims with unusual gifts or entertainment near licence events
indicators.canon: Expense claims with unusual gifts or entertainment near licence events
indicators.desc: Employee expenses for gifts, meals or travel for officials around inspections, permits or renewals.
indicators.ctx: Employee expenses for gifts, meals or travel for officials around inspections, permits or renewals.
indicators.fp: Business courtesies are normal within policy limits.

indicators.name: Fees to distributors well above market margin
indicators.canon: Fees to distributors well above market margin
indicators.desc: Distributor discounts or rebates are unusually large without commercial rationale, leaving room for onward payments.
indicators.ctx: Distributor discounts or rebates are unusually large without commercial rationale, leaving room for onward payments.
indicators.fp: Volume discounts and market entry may justify higher margins.

indicators.name: Joint-venture partner owned by government-connected persons
indicators.canon: Joint-venture partner owned by government-connected persons
indicators.desc: Local partner's owners include officials or relatives without disclosure or fair valuation of their contribution.
indicators.ctx: Local partner's owners include officials or relatives without disclosure or fair valuation of their contribution.
indicators.fp: State-linked partners are common in some sectors and not inherently improper.
